author: Barbara Conway Hala
text: 25-30 higher on finger stick is expected. The sensor is reading glucose in the interstitial fluid beneath the skin. There’s a lag of about 15-20 with what the sensor is reading. It’s supposed to help you stay in range and any time you get a low or high you should do a finger stick. Can’t be relied on as a complete replacement for finger stick.
